sports.headline: FIFA confirms US-led 2031 Women's World Cup and England-led UK bid for 2035
sports.summary: FIFA confirmed the United States will lead a four-nation 2031 Women's World Cup with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica. A UK project led by England was ratified for 2035. Both are uncontested bids for the first 48-team, 104-game editions. Winning bidders and Gianni Infantino promised to reinvest profits in women's football. Netflix said it will be the exclusive US home of the 2031 coverage.

sports.headline: Verstappen wins wild Las Vegas Grand Prix as Ferrari team-mates collide again
sports.summary: Max Verstappen held off a race-long challenge from the Mercedes pair to win by 0.639s from Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri third. There were 34 lead changes and more than 300 overtakes. Charles Leclerc was penalised for a collision with Lewis Hamilton. Verstappen's fourth win in six races all but secures second in the standings, behind champion Kimi Antonelli.

fashion.headline: Paolo Bulgari, architect of the jeweller's rise to global luxury brand, dies at 89
fashion.summary: The Italian jeweller helped lift the international profile of the family firm with bold use of colourful gemstones. His clients included Sophia Loren and Elizabeth Taylor.

fashion.headline: Black Friday is a big deal for luxury, just don't call it Black Friday
fashion.summary: High-end labels are looking to capture Black Friday spending without adopting the discounting that defines the event. BoF reports on how luxury houses are approaching the month-long sales period.

fashion.headline: Nicole Farhi relaunches with 'renewed creative vision'
fashion.summary: The British label has relaunched with a renewed creative direction, reported by TheIndustry.fashion on 23 November.

marketing.headline: F1 sponsorship spend forecast to pass $3bn in 2026 as marketing chiefs question what logos actually buy
marketing.summary: Ampere Analysis forecasts F1 sponsorship spend will pass $3bn in 2026, up 15% on last season and 66% since 2022. Qualcomm's CMO argues deals should be built around brand objectives rather than promises of exposure. Williams recorded the biggest year-on-year revenue jump on the grid, driven by new partners including title sponsor Atlassian. MarketScale summarises original Business Insider reporting by Lara O'Reilly.

marketing.headline: Amazon Prime Video's Black Friday sports slate draws nearly 25% more first-time live-sports advertisers
marketing.summary: Amazon Prime Video's Alan Moss says advertisers new to live sports are up nearly 25% year on year for its 15-hour Black Friday sports programming. More than 100 advertisers are involved, with shoppable and interactive ad formats a key draw.

marketing.headline: BCG: 27% of marketing teams could soon be AI, with agencies set to lose the most
marketing.summary: BCG analysis suggests agency talent could fall from 25% to 16% of the marketing team mix within three years. 73% of CMOs say media agencies are exposed. This is a notable shift for marketing careers and structures.

marketing.headline: A decade in the jungle: Tombola and ITV on the 'compound gains' of the I'm a Celeb sponsorship
marketing.summary: Tombola has sponsored I'm a Celeb for 10 years. The partnership has evolved well beyond traditional TV idents as the media landscape changes.
